method: Read and derive existing W10/W11 records only; no new scan or simulation.

limits: Controlled enemy HP difficulty calibrated to rho = 0.75 * measured single-target DPS * paired actual incoming EHP / (boss HP * stationary raw boss DPS). Authored player build is never rescaled.

Full-health stationary raw/mitigated boss damage and a zero-armour nonattacking DPS target are separate measurements; later boss phases, active defence skills and player behaviour can differ from the nominal power ratio.
Win samples use the actual declared region, landing, obstacles, adds, boss phases, mana, cooldowns, HP, skill and weapon rules. Dead, timed out and invalid samples remain in the denominator.
Twenty seeds distinguish engine random outcomes, not a measured human skill distribution. Thresholds at 99% cannot establish population confidence with only twenty samples.
This Node engine probe does not award rewards or assert PostgreSQL settlement, natural acquisition, full dungeon routing or six-island production completion.

Single newborn character, real earned gear, no grants or reward injection; deterministic World seed, private loot random remains production random.
Single-camp route excludes nearby fights; travel/recovery and confirmed camp waits use estimated/virtual time. This is a route observation, not a human population mean.
Rare minimum pickup filter; no automatic salvage or bag reset. Filtered ground rewards remain pending. Stops on full bag, death or observation budget.
Actual World and actual standard acquisitions; stationary targets are explicitly controlled high-life/zero-attack measurement targets.
The stage10 pair changes the declared first-legendary/set acquisition, at the same character level and identical enemy seeds. It does not prove natural timing.
Manual is an explicit greedy input policy using real movement, casts, cooldowns and mana. It is not human performance. Failed and dead encounters remain reported.

limitations: 单营地自然日程是明确的乐观路线，路径/恢复有估计且排除邻营混战；不冒充真人30小时平均节奏。
任务尝试日程的done列表是实际结果，不能用名称把未做的全部任务算完成；完整任务续接另见all-quests.json。
固定靶标准人和ρ样本是设计构筑/受控敌人HP实验，不代表自然掉落分布或人类胜率。
